full_judgment: 11. It further transpires from the supplementary affidavit sworn by the petitioner on 11.5.2002, enclosing the certified copy of the judgment passed by the Senior Assistant Judge, Balaganj, Sylhet, in Title Suit no. 63 of 2001 (Annexure-L) that he filed the said suit praying for a decree for permanent injunction and also for declaration in respect of the plot no. 241/1. After hearing, his suit was dismissed with cost by the judgment and decree dated 30.10.2001. His appeal being Title Appeal No. 305 of 2001 was also dismissed by the judgment and decree dated 3.4.2002 passed by the Joint District Judge, Artho Rin Court, Sylhet (Annexure-L-1). Thereafter, the petitioner obtained the instant Rule on 11.5.2002.
